notes.title: PhiloDeka Demo Major Update: New Playstyle & New Charmstones!
notes.content: [p]Dear Players,[/p][p][/p][p]We're excited to announce that the free demo for PhiloDeka has received a major content update (v0.5.6.67)! The dev team has been closely following your feedback and has made extensive additions and optimizations based on it.[/p][p][/p][p]Here are the highlights of this update:[/p][p][/p][h3]16 New Charmstones to Unlock New Strategies[/h3][p][/p][p]- "Unused Cards" Build (8 Charmstones): Added 8 new Charmstones designed around "Unused Cards" (cards you don't select), allowing your passed-over cards to generate value. (Unlocks after completing Level 9).[/p][p]- "Pair/General" Build Reinforcement (8 Charmstones): Added 8 new Charmstones to enhance the strategic depth of "Pair" and other general-purpose builds.[/p][p][/p][h3]Introducing "Dual-Form" Charmstones[/h3][p]- Three Charmstones Get an Upgrade: We've unlocked Level III upgrades for 3 popular Charmstones.[/p][p]- Freely Toggle Forms: After upgrading, the Charmstone will have two different effect modes. You can freely switch between them before each level to adapt to the situation.[/p][p][/p][h3]Gameplay and Experience Optimizations[/h3][p][/p][p]- Level Extension: The game has been extended from 9 to 12 levels, providing more room for your builds to grow.[/p][p]- New "Zen Select" Feature: You can now enable "Zen Select" mode in the settings, which helps select cards in sequence with a single click, reducing manual clicking.[/p][p]- Shop Refresh Optimization: We've lowered the Acorn cost for refreshing the shop and increased the number of times you can refresh.[/p][p]- Balance Adjustments: Tweaked the values of some Charmstones, fixed several bugs, and improved UI details.[/p][p][/p][p]We can't wait to see the interesting builds you create with all the new content! Please update your game to experience the new and improved demo.[/p][p]If you run into any issues or have any thoughts or suggestions, please don't hesitate to reach out on our Discord or via the in-game "Feedback" link.[/p][p][/p][p]Happy gaming![/p][p][/p][p]- The PhiloDeka Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: PhiloDeka Free Demo Now Available on Steam – First Update Released!
notes.content:
Dear players,

We’re excited to announce that the [b]free demo[/b] of PhiloDeka is now live on Steam, with its first [b]update [/b]arriving today! Dive into a clean, contemplative Roguelike world.

In this world, the core mechanic revolves around making “Tens.” Mix and match [b]Runes[/b], [b]Rune Skills[/b] and [b]Rune Stones[/b] to craft clever strategies and discover exciting synergies.

[b]Demo Highlights:[/b]

- 2 unique Runes
- 4 distinctive Rune Skills
- 50 tactical Rune Stones
- Full tutorial + the first 8 levels

[b]What’s New in This Update:[/b]

- 1 new level added
- Improved UI/UX and bug fixes
- Balance adjustments to some Rune Stones

Head over to the Steam store and click “[b]Install Demo[/b]” to begin your journey into digital zen!

If you’ve already played the demo, simply update to enjoy the latest improvements.

We welcome your feedback and thoughts in the community—if you enjoy the game, don’t forget to add it to your [b]wishlist[/b] and support our continued development!

May PhiloDeka bring a touch of calm and delight to your daily routine.

— Sincerely,
NonfooStudio
